Go get a few swings in today too. Skip a day and your hands forget.

message.jobless_reincarnation.basic_tuto: Roxy · Mire:
You can use water and earth on their own, can't you? Use both at once and you can stir mud right out of the ground. Understand the chant first, then try spreading it.
Practice on level ground until the mud spreads evenly. A mire hurts no one; it only drags at their feet.
Anything stuck in the mud can still fight back, so don't get too close. While it's slowed, put some distance between you.
A mire laid across the path it has to take works better than one cast once it is already on you. Think about which way it will come.
Practice: once you know Water Ball and Earth Wall, hold %s in your main hand, aim at empty space, and hold %s to study. Releasing early cancels.

Practice: select Mire, aim at flat, dry, open ground within %1$s blocks, hold %2$s, chant, and release. The mire fades after about %3$s seconds and slows nothing while forming or fading; you keep one at a time, and a new cast replaces it. It slows only zombies, husks, skeletons, strays and creepers, and does no harm. Each successful cast counts.

tooltip.jobless_reincarnation.library.wo: A geographical guide to the names and character of the world's countries. Read one name at a time and let distant lands find a place in your mind; when you close it, the world beyond your door feels a little closer.
tooltip.jobless_reincarnation.library.fi: This book turns to Fittoa: the monsters that roam this land and how to deal with them. When an unfamiliar name comes up, stop and think it over. Knowing the dangers nearby is one way of getting to know a place.
tooltip.jobless_reincarnation.library.ma: A textbook for magicians, covering attack magic from beginner to advanced levels. First get a sense of its scope, then sort out the ideas behind each kind of spell. That is the first step toward understanding magic.
tooltip.jobless_reincarnation.library.pe: A fairy tale in which the summoner Perugius and his companions stand against a demon god and save the world. It makes for a lively read; how much of the legend is true is worth pondering once you close the book.
tooltip.jobless_reincarnation.library.th: Three gifted swordsmen from different schools meet and venture into a labyrinth together. An adventure best enjoyed page by page: how will three people with such different strengths look out for one another on one journey?
tooltip.jobless_reincarnation.library.pl: A thick plant dictionary with clear, easy-to-follow illustrations, given to %2$s by Zenith for his fifth birthday. Open it anywhere, look at the picture, then read the words; the giver's care comes through too.
tooltip.jobless_reincarnation.library.ma: This is a library book, not a tome. Reading it does not teach any spells.

A straight stone shot gains dense form with practice, splash impact when practiced, and repeated penetration when adept. Water and lava disperse it.
Hold this book in your main hand and use it on Roxy for this spell’s basic guidance.
screen.jobless_reincarnation.journal.pur: Intermediate earth magic. A single stone that can drive a target back when it deals damage.
screen.jobless_reincarnation.journal.det: Practiced stones splash; adept drills can pierce several targets. Range up to %s blocks. Solid blocks, water and lava stop the shot; front-facing shields can still block it.
screen.jobless_reincarnation.journal.pre: Learn %s first, then study the Stone Cannon Tome to learn it.
message.jobless_reincarnation.basic_tuto: Roxy · Stone Cannon:
Learn Earth Wall first, then try sending a stone forward. Understand the chant before you begin.
Practice on a target first and see how straight it flies. The stone shatters on the first thing it touches, so don't expect it to go around anything.
It hits hard, but you wait a while between shots. Don't fire the moment you see an enemy. Judge the distance, then release.
The knockback is useful too. When something rushes you, driving it back buys you a breath to think about your next move.
Practice: once you know Earth Wall, hold %s in your main hand, aim at empty space, and hold %s to study. Releasing early cancels.
Practice: select Stone Cannon, hold %2$s, chant, and release. It travels at most %1$s blocks, disperses on impact, and does not break blocks.
